data.narrative:
SpectralX is a Series A frontier-tech company in Defense & Security, founded by Asaf Picciotto and IDF special-forces veterans. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage companies, comprising 8 private firms and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Top private peers include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Singularity, and NODA AI.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. Across the 10-company peer set, the median valuation stands at $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $3.0B. The named sample peers—Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B)—are predominantly Series B stage, suggesting comparable maturity and capital deployment profiles to SpectralX's trajectory. This single-method analysis implies a $1.0B median valuation.

The triangulated range supports a valuation of $850M (low) to $1.1B (high), with $1.0B as the central estimate. Key uncertainties include the limited methodological depth—only one triangulation method applied—and SpectralX's specific revenue traction, customer concentration, and IP defensibility relative to the peer set. The stage differential between Series A (target) and predominantly Series B comparables introduces upward bias risk. Investor conviction should be conditioned on underlying operational metrics and market validation.
